name: Intake Level
descriptionSeed: Tier Seven does not have a yard; it has an Intake Level, and it is the best-run reception in the world. You step through, you are received, assessed, fed and routed, and by the time you reach the lift you have a schedule. Nothing unplanned enters the arcology. The planning is the wall.
appearance: A clean, bright receiving level below the arcology proper, the gate arch at one end of a long hall of numbered booths. Every arrival is assigned a booth, a route, a meal and an hour, and all of them are correct.
encounterFlavor: A booth-attendant handing you the itinerary you were about to ask for; a trader discovering her stock has already been sold, at a good price, to someone who needed it; an armed band processed, disarmed and routed before they understand what happened.
